# Jora Mechanical Systems

> Canadian heating, cooling and hot water contractor. Phone 905-667-2823 (24/7), email info@joramechanicalsystems.com.
> Regional sites: GTA, Ontario — https://joramechanical.github.io/gta/ ; Saskatchewan (Saskatoon) — https://joramechanical.github.io/saskatchewan/ ; Calgary, Alberta — coming soon.

## GTA, Ontario

> Licensed heating, cooling, hot water and plumbing contractor serving Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), Ontario, Canada — every city and town in Toronto, Peel, York, Halton and Durham. Phone 905-667-2823, email info@joramechanicalsystems.com, emergency service 24/7. Free in-home quotes. The Saskatchewan (Saskatoon) site is at https://joramechanical.github.io/saskatchewan/.

Licensing: TSSA Registered, 313D Licensed, HRAI Certified, G2 Gas Technician, Ontario Building Code, Permits Pulled, WSIB Covered, Fully Insured.
Brands installed: Lennox, Carrier, Trane, KeepRite, Goodman, Kepler, TOSOT, Midea, Gree, Rinnai, Navien, Rheem, Bradford White, Noritz, AirMax.

## Services
- [Furnace installation & replacement](https://joramechanical.github.io/gta/furnaces/): New high-efficiency gas furnaces, sized for your home and installed to Ontario code by licensed gas technicians.
- [Air conditioner installation](https://joramechanical.github.io/gta/air-conditioners/): Quiet, efficient central air — sized properly, installed cleanly, and backed by licensed refrigeration technicians.
- [Heat pump installation](https://joramechanical.github.io/gta/heat-pumps/): One system that heats and cools. Cold-climate heat pumps keep working deep into Ontario winters — and many qualify for rebates.
- [Tankless water heaters](https://joramechanical.github.io/gta/tankless-water-heaters/): Endless hot water, more floor space and lower standby losses. We install condensing tankless units from the top brands.
- [Air handlers & combo systems](https://joramechanical.github.io/gta/air-handlers/): Hydronic air handlers use hot water from your tankless or boiler to heat your home — and add central air conditioning in the same cabinet.
- [24/7 heating & cooling repair](https://joramechanical.github.io/gta/hvac-repair/): No heat, no cooling or no hot water? Call 905-667-2823 any time — day, night, weekends and holidays.
- [Water heater replacement](https://joramechanical.github.io/gta/water-heaters/): Tank water heaters replaced fast — gas, propane or electric — plus help getting out of rental contracts.
- [Garage & workshop heaters](https://joramechanical.github.io/gta/garage-heaters/): A warm garage or workshop all winter — gas unit heaters, radiant tube heaters or electric heaters, installed safely.
- [Ductwork design & installation](https://joramechanical.github.io/gta/ductwork/): Even the best furnace or heat pump can't keep you comfortable through undersized, leaky ducts. We design, build and fix ductwork.
- [Whole-home humidifiers](https://joramechanical.github.io/gta/humidifiers/): Ontario winters make indoor air very dry. A humidifier on your furnace adds moisture to every room automatically.
- [Smart thermostats](https://joramechanical.github.io/gta/smart-thermostats/): Control your comfort from your phone and save energy with schedules and away modes. Rebates may apply.
- [Plumbing services](https://joramechanical.github.io/gta/plumbing/): Leaks, drains, fixtures and water lines — handled by the same team you trust with your heating and cooling.
- [HRV & ERV ventilation](https://joramechanical.github.io/gta/hrv-erv/): Bring in fresh air and send stale air out — while recovering most of the heat. Ideal for newer, tightly-built homes.
- [Boilers & radiant heating](https://joramechanical.github.io/gta/boilers/): Quiet, even heat for radiators and in-floor systems — including combi boilers that also make your hot water.
- [Indoor air quality](https://joramechanical.github.io/gta/indoor-air-quality/): Better filtration and purification on your existing system — for allergies, pets, renovation dust and wildfire smoke.
- [Maintenance & tune-ups](https://joramechanical.github.io/gta/hvac-maintenance/): A yearly tune-up keeps your system safe and efficient, catches small problems early and helps keep warranties valid.
- [Commercial HVAC](https://joramechanical.github.io/gta/commercial-hvac/): Rooftop units, make-up air, unit heaters and ventilation for shops, offices, restaurants, clinics and plazas.
- [Industrial HVAC](https://joramechanical.github.io/gta/industrial-hvac/): Heating and ventilation for warehouses, workshops and plants — radiant tube heaters, make-up air, exhaust and gas lines.

## Saskatchewan

> Jora Mechanical Systems (Saskatchewan): TSASK-licensed heating, cooling, gas and hot water contractor serving Saskatoon and area (Warman, Martensville, Osler, Dalmeny, Langham, Delisle, Clavet) and communities across Saskatchewan including Regina, Prince Albert and Moose Jaw. Furnaces, garage and shop heaters, boilers, AC, heat pumps, tankless water heaters. SaskEnergy rebate help. Phone 905-667-2823, email info@joramechanicalsystems.com, emergency service 24/7. Free in-home quotes. No general plumbing in Saskatchewan. The Ontario (GTA) site is at https://joramechanical.github.io/gta/.

Licensing: TSASK Licensed, TSASK Gas Fitters, Red Seal Refrigeration, National Building Code, CSA B149 Gas Code, Permits Pulled, WCB Saskatchewan, Fully Insured.
Brands installed: Lennox, Carrier, Trane, Goodman, Kepler, TOSOT, Midea, Gree, Rinnai, Navien, Rheem, Bradford White, Noritz, Modine, Mr. Heater, King, Re-Verber-Ray.

## Services
- [Furnace installation & replacement](https://joramechanical.github.io/saskatchewan/furnaces/): New high-efficiency gas furnaces, sized for a −40 °C prairie winter and installed by TSASK-licensed gas fitters with a TSASK gas permit.
- [Air conditioner installation](https://joramechanical.github.io/saskatchewan/air-conditioners/): Prairie summers hit 30 °C+. Quiet, efficient central air — sized properly and installed by journeyperson refrigeration mechanics.
- [Heat pump installation](https://joramechanical.github.io/saskatchewan/heat-pumps/): One system that heats and cools. In Saskatchewan we pair cold-climate heat pumps with a gas furnace so you're never left cold at −40 °C.
- [Tankless water heaters](https://joramechanical.github.io/saskatchewan/tankless-water-heaters/): Endless hot water, more space in the basement — and a $1,000 SaskEnergy rebate on qualifying units installed by a TSASK-licensed contractor.
- [Garage & shop heaters](https://joramechanical.github.io/saskatchewan/garage-heaters/): Start the truck in a warm garage at −35 °C. Gas unit heaters, ceramic infrared heaters, electric heaters and patio heaters — installed with a TSASK permit.
- [24/7 heating & cooling repair](https://joramechanical.github.io/saskatchewan/hvac-repair/): No heat at −30 °C is an emergency. Call 905-667-2823 any time — day, night, weekends and holidays.
- [Water heater replacement](https://joramechanical.github.io/saskatchewan/water-heaters/): Tank water heaters replaced fast — gas, propane or electric — with SaskEnergy rebates of $250 to $1,000 on qualifying models.
- [Ductwork design & installation](https://joramechanical.github.io/saskatchewan/ductwork/): Cold bonus rooms over the garage and chilly basements are usually duct problems. We design, build and fix ductwork.
- [Whole-home humidifiers](https://joramechanical.github.io/saskatchewan/humidifiers/): Prairie winter air is extremely dry. A humidifier on your furnace adds moisture to every room automatically.
- [Smart thermostats](https://joramechanical.github.io/saskatchewan/smart-thermostats/): Check on your home's heat from anywhere — and get an alert if the furnace stops while you're away in January.
- [HRV & ERV ventilation](https://joramechanical.github.io/saskatchewan/hrv-erv/): Fresh air in, stale air out — while recovering most of the heat. ENERGY STAR HRVs qualify for a $100 SaskEnergy rebate.
- [Boilers & in-floor heating](https://joramechanical.github.io/saskatchewan/boilers/): Quiet, even heat for in-floor radiant slabs, garages, shops and radiators — with SaskEnergy rebates up to $2,000.
- [Indoor air quality](https://joramechanical.github.io/saskatchewan/indoor-air-quality/): Better filtration on your furnace — for prairie dust, allergies, pets and summer wildfire smoke.
- [Maintenance & tune-ups](https://joramechanical.github.io/saskatchewan/hvac-maintenance/): A yearly tune-up before the first hard freeze keeps your heat safe and reliable — and helps keep warranties valid.
- [Commercial HVAC](https://joramechanical.github.io/saskatchewan/commercial-hvac/): Rooftop units, make-up air, unit heaters and ventilation for shops, offices, restaurants, clinics and plazas.
- [Industrial & shop HVAC](https://joramechanical.github.io/saskatchewan/industrial-hvac/): Heating and ventilation for warehouses, farm shops, quonsets and plants — radiant tube heaters, unit heaters, make-up air, exhaust and gas lines.
